desc: **Derive/verify the invariant:** operation maps gaps (d_i, d_{i+1}, d_{i+2}) → (d_{i+2}, d_{i+1}, d_i), X_1 fixed; reachable states = arbitrary permutations within odd-index and even-index gap classes.
**Derive the objective:** sum = N·X_1 + Σ_{j=1}^{N−1}(N−j)·d_j; greedy = sort each parity class ascending against descending weights (rearrangement inequality).
**Validate formula on samples by reasoning:** N=4 → 21, N=6 → 41.
**Implement the solution** (buffered I/O, parity-split gaps, sort ascending, weighted sum, pure integer arithmetic).
**Correctness cross-check:** hand-verified both samples; permutation-group argument confirms reachable set exactly.
**Performance & edge cases:** O(N log N) for N up to 2·10^5, X up to 10^12, no floats, equally-spaced input yields the initial sum.
